samples.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: art-direction preview for a Vietnamese animated history explainer, landscape 16:9.
Primary request: a beautifully drawn, professional 2D ink-and-flat-color illustration of Angkor Wat, much more thoughtfully crafted than a geometric diagram. Style direction 1: expressive black ink on warm white, restrained sandstone ochre and muted blue-green.
Subject and composition: recognizable Angkor Wat viewed from across its moat, a stone causeway leading toward the sanctuary. A generous, elegantly framed wide illustration. Authentic lotus-bud towers arranged as a central sanctuary and four corners with natural perspective occlusion, layered galleries, rising terraces, carved pillars and convincing stairways. Do not make five identical towers lined in a row. Do not confuse Angkor Wat with the faces of Bayon. Distinct architectural silhouette, selective intricate carved detail, organic varied line weight, confident curved ink contours, restrained small areas of hatching. Some carefully composed foliage and ripples frame the temple, with substantial clean warm-white space. Temple is visually dominant and readable at animation-screen size.
Medium: polished hand-inked editorial cartoon illustration with subtle two-tone cel shadows; richly observed shapes, NOT simplistic icon art, NOT an engineering drawing, NOT photorealism or a 3D render. The whole scene has a unified drawing language suitable for an educational animated film.
No people, narrator, pointing characters, labels, captions, lettering, borders, watermark, diagrams, arrows, or UI. One finished illustration, not a contact sheet. Opaque background.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: art-direction preview for a Vietnamese animated history explainer, landscape 16:9.
Primary request: a polished 2D animated-film illustration of Angkor Wat. Style direction 2: sophisticated flat-color comic artwork, crisp expressive dark ink outlines, 3-value cel shading, warm sandstone against cool teal water and layered leafy greens.
Subject and composition: Angkor Wat from across the moat, a central stone causeway receding toward the temple in a convincing slightly oblique perspective. Recognizable lotus-bud spires on the real central-and-four-corners architectural arrangement with natural occlusion. Richly designed galleries, columns, terraces and stairs, a few selected relief details. Avoid five cloned towers in a single row, Bayon stone faces or generic Thai pagodas. Foreground leaves frame the corners, water in the middle distance, sanctuary in the main plane, sparse sky behind. Clearly separated visual depth, strong focal hierarchy. Organic, appealing shapes with subtle asymmetry and a harmonious limited palette. Beautiful draftsmanship and balanced composition, like a finished background for a serious but approachable animated documentary, not a tourist infographic.
Medium: clean hand-drawn comic / vector-friendly animation style, controlled detail, broad readable colored shapes, no photographic texture, no glossy 3D lighting.
No people, presenters, pointing characters, labels, text, lettering, diagrams, arrows, border, watermark, or UI. One complete illustration, not a collage. Opaque background.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: art-direction preview for a Vietnamese animated history explainer, landscape 16:9.
Primary request: a refined hand-painted 2D animation background of Angkor Wat. Style direction 3: editorial gouache, tactile matte brushwork, lightly visible ink drawing, warm stone and soft cool blue-green shadows.
Subject and composition: recognizable Angkor Wat across the moat with a stone causeway guiding the eye toward the sanctuary. Wide composition, slightly oblique view, natural perspective depth. Architectural identity matters: sculpted lotus-bud towers in a central quincunx arrangement, layered long galleries and ascending terraces, beautifully selected carved detail. No five identical towers arranged side by side, no Bayon faces, no generic fantasy palace. Temple occupies the main image, water and sparse foreground foliage provide depth; light morning haze separates the far trees. Carefully designed silhouettes and subtle reflected light in water; artistic, coherent, approachable, richly crafted but still readable for an animated explanation.
Medium: finished 2D gouache illustration with controlled texture and broad paint shapes, NOT a photo, NOT photorealistic digital painting, NOT a 3D render. Luminous muted ochres, sage green, deep teal, pale creamy sky; no oversaturated sunset.
No people, narrators, pointing characters, labels, text, lettering, diagrams, arrows, borders, watermark, or UI. One complete illustration, not a contact sheet. Opaque background.
